name: VIBE-Seedream4.0
description: VIBE-Seedream4.0 is a vision benchmark for evaluating models on 3D human pose and shape reconstruction from video or image input. It emphasizes accurate dynamic motion capture and the fidelity of reconstructed meshes across challenging motions and viewpoints. Benchmarks typically measure joint position and mesh reconstruction errors.
reputation: Moderately used within the 3D human reconstruction and pose-estimation research community.
